packageRules.description: Release notes are matched against `<depName>-<version>`, and netbox-chart tags its releases `netbox-x.y.z`. Without this the full OCI ref never matches and PRs come out without a changelog

The dev release tracks mogenius' `develop` prerelease train, which is unstable by definition. `allowedVersions` keeps it on that train so a stable `x.y.z` (which sorts above any of its prereleases) never gets proposed here
